title: Tiny, cute piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- piano body -->
  <rect x="12" y="34" width="76" height="42" rx="8" fill="#8B3A62" />
  <rect x="16" y="38" width="68" height="34" rx="5" fill="#A84673" />
  <!-- top lid shine -->
  <rect x="18" y="36" width="64" height="6" rx="3" fill="#C96A93" />
  <!-- keyboard area -->
  <rect x="16" y="58" width="68" height="16" rx="3" fill="#2E1A3A" />
  <!-- white keys -->
  <rect x="20" y="60" width="8" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF4E6" />
  <rect x="30" y="60" width="8" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF4E6" />
  <rect x="40" y="60" width="8" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF4E6" />
  <rect x="50" y="60" width="8" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF4E6" />
  <rect x="60" y="60" width="8" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF4E6" />
  <rect x="70" y="60" width="8" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF4E6" />
  <!-- black keys -->
  <rect x="25" y="60" width="5" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#3B2450" />
  <rect x="35" y="60" width="5" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#3B2450" />
  <rect x="45" y="60" width="5" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#3B2450" />
  <rect x="55" y="60" width="5" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#3B2450" />
  <rect x="65" y="60" width="5" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#3B2450" />
  <rect x="75" y="60" width="5" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#3B2450" />
  <!-- cute face on lid -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="48" r="4" fill="#1E1228" />
  <circle cx="60" cy="48" r="4" fill="#1E1228" />
  <circle cx="41" cy="47" r="1.8" fill="#FFD166" />
  <circle cx="61" cy="47" r="1.8" fill="#FFD166" />
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M43 52 Q50 57 57 52" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- little legs -->
  <rect x="24" y="76" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#8B3A62" />
  <rect x="68" y="76" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#8B3A62" />
  <!-- music notes -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="26" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#FFD166" />
  <rect x="83" y="14" width="2" height="12" fill="#FFD166" />
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="22" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#FFD166" />
  <rect x="69" y="10" width="2" height="12" fill="#FFD166" />
</svg>
